declarations.name: AuiAlert

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: Tone: icon, colors, and hidden tone prefix.

inputs.name: live
inputs.description: off: static; polite: role=status; assertive: role=alert. Announces content inserted or changed after load.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Buttons { label, value, variant? } that emit aui-action.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the tone prefix and dismiss label.

outputs.name: dismissed
outputs.description: Before the alert hides; preventDefault keeps it visible.

properties.name: isDismissed
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the alert was dismissed (hidden).

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Emit cancelable aui-dismiss, then hide unless prevented. Returns whether it was dismissed.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Alert pattern (role=alert) for urgent dynamic messages; role=status for polite updates; plain content when static.

limitations: Live roles only announce content inserted or changed after the live region exists; an alert rendered with the initial page is not announced (use live 'off' for static content).
After dismissal via its button, focus is not moved by the component; handle aui-dismiss to move focus to a sensible element.
Dismissal is not persisted; the consumer decides whether to render the alert again.
